capabilities.name: Equipment positioning (high-precision GPS and GNSS base stations)
capabilities.desc: Apply Company-provided coordinates to high-precision GPS units in Company Supplied and Contractor Supplied Equipment; provide GNSS base stations or correction services and field-to-office survey data transfer.
capabilities.risk: GPS unit supply for Contractor Supplied Equipment and the number of units are not stated.
capabilities.impact: Hardware and licence allowance depends on fleet size, which is not in the pack (RFI-012).
inputs: Fleet list with GPS/on-board unit count
GNSS base station and correction service quote

capabilities.name: Blast and geotechnical monitoring instruments
capabilities.desc: Provide blast monitoring equipment; install, maintain and collect data from geotechnical monitoring systems as directed by the Company-appointed Site Geotechnical Engineer, and operate any Company-provided monitoring systems.
capabilities.risk: Instrument types, quantities and monitoring frequency are not stated; Company retains the geotechnical model and design authority.
capabilities.impact: Allowance only; direction by the Site Geotechnical Engineer may change quantities during the Works.
inputs: Geotechnical monitoring plan and instrument schedule

capabilities.name: Weighbridge and weighing instrumentation (Mine Access Road)
capabilities.desc: Weighbridge listed with the weed and seed facility in the Mine Access Road mechanical and E&I areas. Equipment supply, weighing software, calibration and operator are not stated.
capabilities.risk: Installation is implied by the area list only; no specification, capacity or data requirement is given.
capabilities.impact: Cannot separate civil, mechanical, E&I and system costs; supply could be free-issue or Contractor.
capabilities.note: Position rests on the mechanical and E&I area lists; supply responsibility is open.
inputs: Weighbridge specification, capacity and calibration regime

capabilities.name: Main Site Access Gate and boom-gate access control
capabilities.desc: Company operates and administers the Main Site Access Gate, boom gates and access control systems and maintains the infrastructure.
capabilities.risk: Contractor workforce access rules and credentials are not stated.
capabilities.impact: No installation cost; interface and induction effort only.

capabilities.name: Mining Exclusion Area and Contractor-controlled area access control
capabilities.desc: Establish and maintain demarcation, signage, barriers, gates and access controls for the Mining Exclusion Area and Contractor-controlled areas, with radio and traffic protocols.
capabilities.risk: Whether access control is electronic or physical is not stated.
capabilities.impact: Physical works are priced under existing EWPs; any electronic access system is unquantified.
inputs: Access control philosophy for exclusion areas

capabilities.name: CCTV, access control and alarm devices (Explosives Facility and NPI)
capabilities.desc: Install free-issued cameras, detectors, access control and alarm devices at the Explosives Facility and connect to the NVR (network video recorder) in the monitoring room, but the exclusions list removes backbone fibre, CCTV and access control systems.
capabilities.risk: Direct conflict between installation text and exclusion text; extends RFI-011.
capabilities.impact: Either an unpriced installation scope or a double-count if excluded.
capabilities.note: Input workbook holds WIN-1000-18 as Exclude and WIN-1000-17 as Price.
inputs: Camera and access device schedule, NVR location

capabilities.name: Field instrumentation installation (flow, level, pressure, analysers, samplers)
capabilities.desc: Install, test, calibrate and pre-commission instruments on bores, pump stations, utilities and NPI facilities, including Company-supplied instruments listed as 'Contractor installed', with brackets, stands, junction boxes, tubing and loop checks. ITT sets instrument requirements (smart HART transmitters, 4-20 mA).
capabilities.risk: Project instrumentation list, equipment list and cable schedule are referenced but not in the pack.
capabilities.impact: Instrument counts cannot be priced; loop-check effort is open-ended.

capabilities.name: Water flow metering for abstraction and discharge records
capabilities.desc: Water abstracted or discharged only from Company-nominated licensed locations and recorded via calibrated flowmeter, with monthly reporting.
capabilities.risk: Number and location of meters not stated.
capabilities.impact: Low unit value; reporting effort sits in HSESC indirects.
inputs: Water licence locations and metering points

capabilities.name: Aerodrome automated weather indicator and airfield aids
capabilities.desc: Airfield lighting, PAPI (precision approach path indicator), wind direction indicator and Automated Weather Indicator Services (AWIS) listed with the aerodrome E&I scope.
capabilities.risk: The aerodrome E&I list sits in the bulk earthworks work area description, so package ownership is unclear.
capabilities.impact: Possible boundary overlap between earthworks and E&I estimators.

capabilities.name: Process plant control systems (PLC, DCS, SCADA, HMI) and EI&C
capabilities.desc: MPP electrical, instrumentation and communications systems are excluded. PLC (programmable logic controller), DCS (distributed control system), SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) and HMI (human-machine interface) for the plant belong to the MPP EPC Contractor.
capabilities.risk: Pre-commissioning wording (s15.2) reads as covering all systems in every area (RFI-011).
capabilities.impact: Boundary tie-in effort only if the exclusion holds.

capabilities.name: NPI controls and instrumentation: supply, install, calibrate, test
capabilities.desc: Supply, install, calibrate and test controls and instrumentation for MSA safe and reliable operation, and install instrumentation, controls and monitoring for the Village raw water, potable ring main, UV unit, sewage, emergency power and gas reticulation.
capabilities.risk: Supply of controllers and panels is not separated from installation; 'controls' content (PLC, RTU, local panels) is not defined.
capabilities.impact: Vendor quote needed for panels and controllers; scope may be install-only.
inputs: I/O list and control panel schedule

capabilities.name: Supervisory control: PLC/RTU programming, SCADA, HMI and central control system integration
capabilities.desc: Telemetry to the central control system and integration of the Contractor's E&I back to the control room in the MSA. The ITT does not name the control system, its supplier, or who programs and commissions it.
capabilities.risk: Programming and integration may be assumed by the Owner or by the Contractor; the ITT says only 'integration back to the control room'.
capabilities.impact: Largest unquantified systems exposure in SP2 E&I; high rework risk if integration is Contractor-led.
capabilities.note: Control room is part of MSA item 18 (SRC-1035, p272).
inputs: Control system architecture and network diagram
Integration specification for MSA control room

capabilities.name: Alarm management
capabilities.desc: No alarm philosophy or alarm management requirement is stated.
capabilities.risk: Alarm rationalisation could be assumed as part of commissioning.
capabilities.impact: None priced; watch for scope creep via commissioning support.
capabilities.note: Search basis: ITT page text (638 pages) contains no alarm management or alarm philosophy; the only alarm references are fire alarm panels and security alarm devices.

capabilities.name: Electrical protection settings application and testing
capabilities.desc: Apply and test protection settings per engineering studies and design for installed electrical equipment.
capabilities.risk: Protection studies are not in the pack.
capabilities.impact: Relay engineering support may need a specialist subcontractor.

capabilities.name: Fire detection and alarm panels and site-wide fire system interface
capabilities.desc: Fire detection and alarm for all buildings, with a master fire alarm control panel (FACP) in the Emergency Response Facility and dedicated panels for hazardous facilities; interface to configure the site-wide fire detection system.
capabilities.risk: Fire system supplier and configuration owner not stated.
capabilities.impact: Configuration effort may sit with the Owner's fire system integrator.
inputs: Fire detection design and FACP schedule

capabilities.name: Fleet management system (FMS): tracking, dispatch, status, cycle and production monitoring
capabilities.desc: Provide, install, commission, operate and maintain an FMS from the start of pre-strip (allow Wenco or Company-approved equivalent for the full pre-strip duration): software, licences, on-board equipment, servers, operator interfaces, mesh network, repeaters and repeater trailers. Minimum functions: fleet tracking and dispatch, equipment status and utilisation, haul cycle and production monitoring, source-to-destination material tracking.
capabilities.risk: Fleet size, pre-strip duration, on-board unit count and who supplies on-board units for Company free-issue HME are not stated; redundancy and spares at Contractor cost; migration to a Company FMS is open-ended.
capabilities.impact: Vendor-quote driven; licence term and per-unit charges scale with fleet and duration; operating resource (supervision and dispatch) is a recurring cost.
capabilities.note: ISA-95 has no FMS object. Adaptation: FMS treated as Level 3 production operations dispatching and tracking.
inputs: Fleet list and unit count (HME and light vehicles)
FMS vendor quote (software, licences, on-board, servers, mesh)
Mine coverage design and repeater count
FMS staffing model and shift pattern

capabilities.name: Mine scheduling and dispatch operations (daily and fortnightly plans)
capabilities.desc: Daily and fortnightly mine planning from the Company Life of Mine plan and Three Month Production Plan; scheduling and dispatch operations and material tracking system from pit block model to final dump. Daily plan before each shift; fortnightly plan two days before each fortnight, for approval.
capabilities.risk: Mine planning software and block model access are not stated; plan tolerance (+5% / -10% cumulative) carries payment risk.
capabilities.impact: Planning resource and software licences are not separately priceable from the ITT.
inputs: Mine planning software and block model access arrangement

capabilities.name: Material tracking and reconciliation from pit to final destination
capabilities.desc: Material tracking supports allocation and reconciliation of pre-strip material delivered to the TSF (tailings storage facility), ROM (run-of-mine pad), stockpile bases, haul roads and waste rock landforms. Contractor keeps mine planning, survey, material classification and destination information current in the FMS.
capabilities.risk: Pre-strip to TSF pricing split depends on a transfer node not in the pack (RFI-009).
capabilities.impact: Reconciliation basis for payment; disputes arise if tracking data and survey differ.
capabilities.note: Adaptation: ISA-95 material movement and tracking applied to bulk mining material; placed under inventory operations.

capabilities.name: Stockpile management and inventory (ore and construction material)
capabilities.desc: Deliver and stockpile process feed (named material types), mine and stockpile the first approximately 600 kt of ore, manage stockpiles as required; survey quantities and stockpiles through the Works. Rehandle from stockpiles to the crusher is excluded.
capabilities.risk: Stockpile inventory system, grade information and cut-off are not stated.
capabilities.impact: Quantities by survey only; no inventory system priced unless Company directs.
capabilities.note: Adaptation: stockpile inventory mapped to ISA-95 inventory operations.
inputs: Stockpile design and material type register

capabilities.name: Production reporting and data export to Company
capabilities.desc: Provide FMS production and movement data in an agreed electronic format for reconciliation and incorporation into Company reporting systems. For pricing, no live or automated interface is required; regular structured data exports are required.
capabilities.risk: Agreed format and frequency not stated; any move to a live interface changes scope.
capabilities.impact: Export scripting and reporting effort; a later live-interface direction is a variation risk.

capabilities.name: Drill and blast records and blast performance management
capabilities.desc: Maintain blast plans, drill logs, charging records, explosive reconciliations and statutory records; contractor is responsible for blast performance (fragmentation, vibration, flyrock, airblast, fumes, misfires).
capabilities.risk: Blast design software and electronic detonator programming tools are not stated.
capabilities.impact: Software and licence allowance; performance risk sits in drill and blast rates.
capabilities.note: Adaptation: blast performance placed under quality operations.
inputs: Blast design and records software requirement

capabilities.name: Ore and waste classification and grade control
capabilities.desc: Recover ore per plan, identify and segregate TSF construction material and avoid mixing ore, overburden and waste on spillage. No grade control sampling, assay or block-model update responsibility is stated.
capabilities.risk: Ore loss and dilution accountability without a defined grade control process.
capabilities.impact: Unpriced sampling, assay and survey effort if Contractor-led.
capabilities.note: Adaptation: grade control placed under quality operations.
inputs: Grade control and sampling responsibility statement

capabilities.name: Survey and quantity data collection
capabilities.desc: Quantity surveys, progress-payment survey data and as-built survey, with Company check surveys; certified surveyor; DTM (digital terrain model) submitted for approval; datum MGA GDA94 Zone 51 and AHD.
capabilities.risk: Survey control establishment is excluded; rework from survey error is at Contractor cost.
capabilities.impact: Survey equipment and software are indirects; DTM approval timing affects payment.
capabilities.note: Adaptation: survey data collection mapped to production operations data collection.

capabilities.name: Maintenance management of fleet (maintenance execution, equipment records)
capabilities.desc: Operate and maintain Company Supplied Equipment and facilities: maintenance execution, inspections, servicing, condition monitoring, statutory compliance, equipment records and operating data; provide maintenance histories and asset-health data at handback.
capabilities.risk: No CMMS (computerised maintenance management system) is named; responsibility matrices are not in the pack.
capabilities.impact: Maintenance system licence and data capture effort unquantified.
inputs: HME and construction equipment scope and responsibility matrices

capabilities.name: Maintenance management interface (asset registration and handover data)
capabilities.desc: Company retains HME ownership and asset registration; the Contractor supplies equipment records, manufacturing data records (including instrument calibration reports), loop checks and as-built dossiers at handover. The Company CMMS is not named.
capabilities.risk: Tag and data structure for handover is not defined.
capabilities.impact: Documentation effort; late format direction causes rework.
inputs: Asset data handover standard and tag convention

capabilities.name: Construction testing and field laboratory (NATA accredited)
capabilities.desc: Mobilise, establish and operate a field laboratory on Site (NATA accredited where applicable) with minimum capability (AS 1289 soil tests, HDPE seam testing, concrete cylinders, Leco analysis of mine waste); all testing at Contractor cost; on-Site or nominated off-Site laboratory.
capabilities.risk: Test volumes are not stated; laboratory may be on-Site or off-Site.
capabilities.impact: Laboratory equipment, accreditation and staffing allowance; no test quantities in the pack.
capabilities.note: Adaptation: construction materials testing mapped to quality operations.

capabilities.name: Permanent MSA laboratory equipment
capabilities.desc: MSA laboratory building and sample storage are built by the Contractor; laboratory equipment for the permanent laboratory is excluded.
capabilities.risk: Services provision to the laboratory (power, data points) must still be coordinated.
capabilities.impact: Building and services only; no equipment cost.
capabilities.note: Building (WIN-1400-06-02) is priced in EWP-STR-02.

capabilities.name: Laboratory information management system (LIMS)
capabilities.desc: No LIMS requirement is stated for the field laboratory or the permanent laboratory.
capabilities.risk: Results reporting format to Company may be directed later.
capabilities.impact: None priced.
capabilities.note: Search basis: no LIMS or laboratory information system term in the ITT page text.

capabilities.name: Operational historian and shift reporting
capabilities.desc: No historian or shift-handover reporting system is stated. Shift-level planning is covered by the daily production plan (CAP-L3-MIN-02).
capabilities.risk: Company may direct reporting after award.
capabilities.impact: None priced.
capabilities.note: Search basis: no historian term in the ITT page text.

capabilities.name: Materials control and inventory system (receipt, storage, spares, reconciliation)
capabilities.desc: Materials Management Plan with qualified personnel, systems and facilities; a materials control system tracking ID, location, quantity, inspection, preservation, NCR (non-conformance report), installation and surplus or spare status; periodic inventory counts and reconciliation; inventory register; warehousing and inventory control for spares; pre-Completion reconciliation and handover.
capabilities.risk: No volume, value, warehouse size or end date for surplus and spares (SRC-1367); system platform not stated.
capabilities.impact: Software licences and storekeeping resource scale with unquantified volumes.
inputs: Free-issue equipment list and Company Supplied Items list
Materials control system platform and licence requirement

capabilities.name: Cargo and delivery tracking (Port Hedland to Site)
capabilities.desc: Controlled delivery management: scheduling, call-up, site readiness, unloading resources, cargo tracking, shortage and damage management; documented receipt inspection; shortage or damage reported to the Company Representative within 48 hours.
capabilities.risk: Tracking tool and carrier reporting requirements not stated.
capabilities.impact: Logistics system licences are indirects; volume driven.
capabilities.note: Adaptation: inbound logistics tracking mapped to inventory operations.

capabilities.name: Train and port loadout coordination
capabilities.desc: No product haulage, rail or port loadout scope. The only port reference is inbound transport from the Port Battery Limit to Site; the concentrate loop road is earthworks only.
capabilities.risk: None identified.
capabilities.impact: None.
capabilities.note: Search basis: no loadout or train loading term in the ITT page text; Port Hedland references relate to inbound cargo.

capabilities.name: Fuel management and monitoring (FOBs, meters, reports, inventory control)
capabilities.desc: Operate temporary site fuel storage, receive deliveries, control inventory and quality; implement fuel monitoring and reporting including FOBs (fuel tags), fuel management software or meters and regular usage reports. Company supplies diesel; Contractor is responsible for fuel burn and refuelling of free-issued equipment.
capabilities.risk: Fleet and tank counts not stated; fuel system must link to FMS if Company expects integrated data.
capabilities.impact: Software and meter hardware priced from vendor quotes once fleet is known.
capabilities.note: Adaptation: fuel inventory treated as inventory operations.

capabilities.name: Waste tracking and landfill records
capabilities.desc: Waste Management Plan identifying waste streams, volumes, segregation, disposal, carriers and tracking; landfill access control, permitted waste only, records of volumes and waste types, licence compliance.
capabilities.risk: Landfill construction, capacity and third-party waste acceptance are open (RFI-017).
capabilities.impact: Records are low cost; landfill operation sits in indirects.
capabilities.note: Adaptation: waste movement records mapped to inventory operations.

capabilities.name: Process plant production tracking and product sampling
capabilities.desc: MPP covers ROM handling, crushing, grinding, gravity gold and product sampling and handling; top-of-concrete plant works are excluded and belong to the MPP EPC Contractor.
capabilities.risk: Plant start-up needs mine ore delivery data from the FMS.
capabilities.impact: None priced.

capabilities.name: Life of Mine plan and Three Month Production Plan (production schedule)
capabilities.desc: Company owns the Life of Mine plan and issues the Three Month Production Plan monthly; plan tolerance cumulative +5% / -10%; mine design may change.
capabilities.risk: Plan changes drive resource and fleet utilisation.
capabilities.impact: Variation and utilisation risk, not a system cost.

capabilities.name: Enterprise resource planning (ERP): finance and procurement interface
capabilities.desc: Invoices must quote the Company SAP purchase order number and go to the Company invoice address; Company ERP is not the Contractor's to supply.
capabilities.risk: Portal rules and query handling.
capabilities.impact: Administration effort only.

capabilities.name: Planning, scheduling and cost reporting deliverables (P6, Schedule of Values)
capabilities.desc: CPM network in Primavera P6 (v8 or later) submitted monthly as .XER and .pdf; Schedule of Values drives pricing and invoicing and populates the Company cost control system; planning and reporting per Appendix E.
capabilities.risk: Company WBS and Schedule of Values not in the pack (GAP-262).
capabilities.impact: Planner resource and software licence in indirects.
inputs: Company WBS and Schedule of Values

capabilities.name: Corporate and Company reporting systems
capabilities.desc: Company reporting systems receive FMS production and movement data via agreed exports; the Company's data systems are not described.
capabilities.risk: Target system and format unknown.
capabilities.impact: None for MinRes beyond export.

capabilities.name: Temporary communications, IT and data infrastructure (construction and pre-strip)
capabilities.desc: Contractor is fully self-sufficient: provide, install, commission, operate and maintain all temporary telephone, mobile, radio, internet, network and IT infrastructure, including connectivity for administration, reporting, remote support, survey and the FMS. Do not assume Company internet or data services.
capabilities.risk: Coverage area, user count and duration are not stated; Contractor bears all costs, including redundancy.
capabilities.impact: Allowance in EWP-IND-03 mixes laydown, water and communications; needs a communications specialist.
capabilities.note: Primary domain assigned to Mining (Assumption OPS-A-04).
inputs: Site layout, work fronts and user counts
Temporary network and internet service quote

capabilities.name: Temporary radio solution, licences and transition to Company TETRA
capabilities.desc: Assume the Company permanent TETRA radio network is not available for construction or pre-strip; provide a complete temporary radio solution, radios for all supervisors and no mobile equipment without radio; obtain radio licences and frequency allocations including crane frequencies; support transition to the Company network when available.
capabilities.risk: Equipment responsibility matrix not in the pack; radios in Company Supplied Equipment are maintained by the Contractor.
capabilities.impact: Radio quantity depends on fleet and workforce; licence and frequency lead time.

capabilities.name: Site-wide communication system installation (fibre, towers, private LTE, VMR hardware)
capabilities.desc: Install, test and commission a site-wide communication system including fibre optic, data centres, communication towers, private LTE (long-term evolution mobile network) and VMR (voice mobile radio) hardware; install Company-supplied fibre, patch panels, FOBOTs (fibre optic breakout terminals); supply splicing and termination kits; fibre testing and as-builts.
capabilities.risk: Cable lengths, building count and tower equipment models (some Tbc) are not given.
capabilities.impact: Splicing and testing quantities cannot be derived; Company supply timing drives delay risk.
inputs: Fibre cable schedule and route plan
Tower equipment lists (Tables 1 and 2) with final models

capabilities.name: Data centres DC1 and DC2 installation
capabilities.desc: Take delivery, store, preserve and install the modular prefabricated data centres per OEM manual: support steel and platforms, dedicated LV generator, HVAC and refrigerant lines, gaseous fire suppression, cable ladder, interconnecting cabling, lighting and earthing. DC1 supports a backup control room function.
capabilities.risk: Module delivery sequence and Company IT equipment installation boundary not stated.
capabilities.impact: Install effort priced from OEM manual; building shell is in EWP-STR-02.
inputs: Data centre OEM installation manual and layout
Generator and fire suppression subcontract quote

capabilities.name: Communications towers (40 m and 80 m)
capabilities.desc: Assemble and install steel communication towers (80 m in-situ foundation; 40 m precast footing with tower by manufacturer); install Company-supplied antennas, panels, radio equipment, feeders and trays; Telstra carrier equipment on mine towers.
capabilities.risk: Foundation size is estimated only; equipment models Tbc; carrier scope boundary.
capabilities.impact: Structural and equipment installation split across EWP-STR-03 and EWP-ICT-01.

capabilities.name: Village communications network and data/TV distribution (GPON, IPTV, Wi-Fi)
capabilities.desc: Supply and install Village communications network: fibre optic cabling, GPON (gigabit passive optical network) distribution, IPTV outlets, Wi-Fi in all buildings, Cat 6 patch panels, Optical Line Transmitter with SFP+ uplink to the plant core network.
capabilities.risk: Listed as 1 lot with no dimensions; building and room counts drive quantities.
capabilities.impact: Vendor quote needed; accommodation services content is not an operational system.
capabilities.note: Relevant as shared infrastructure; low operational systems impact.

capabilities.name: MSA communications systems and ICT hardware
capabilities.desc: Communications systems designed by others and integrated with the site-wide LAN and WAN, but the Contractor installs and mounts all loose ICT hardware and tests structured cabling to IS&T requirements. Input workbook records WIN-1400-12 as Excluded, which may omit this installation.
capabilities.risk: Installation text conflicts with the excluded FLOC; possible unpriced installation.
capabilities.impact: Install and test effort not priced if WIN-1400-12 is held as Exclude.
capabilities.note: Review the Exclude decision on WIN-1400-12.
inputs: ICT hardware list and MSA structured cabling design

capabilities.name: Backbone fibre and network distribution
capabilities.desc: Backbone fibre and network fibre distribution for the Project is provided and installed by others up to the FOBOT; the exclusions list names backbone fibre.
capabilities.risk: Battery limit at the FOBOT and conduit works need coordination.
capabilities.impact: Interface and testing coordination only.

capabilities.name: Cybersecurity compliance for systems interfacing with Company networks
capabilities.desc: Contractor systems interfacing with Company networks or systems must comply with the Company's applicable IT and cyber security requirements. The requirements are not in the pack.
capabilities.risk: Unknown controls could require segmentation, monitoring or audits.
capabilities.impact: Open-ended compliance effort.
capabilities.note: Statement is on PDF page 228; the register evidence note for SRC-0499 does not itemise it.
inputs: Company IT and cyber security requirements

capabilities.name: Operational technology (OT) network segmentation and industrial cybersecurity architecture
capabilities.desc: No OT cybersecurity architecture, zones or industrial security standard is stated.
capabilities.risk: Could be directed after award.
capabilities.impact: None priced.
capabilities.note: Search basis: no IEC 62443 or industrial cybersecurity architecture term in the ITT page text.

capabilities.name: Time synchronisation
capabilities.desc: No time synchronisation requirement is stated.
capabilities.risk: None identified.
capabilities.impact: None.
capabilities.note: Search basis: no NTP or time synchronisation term in the ITT page text.

capabilities.name: Master data, data model and tagging convention
capabilities.desc: No data model or tagging convention is stated; equipment, instrumentation and cable lists are referenced but not in the pack.
capabilities.risk: Handover data structure may be directed after award.
capabilities.impact: None priced.
capabilities.note: Search basis: no data model or tagging standard in the ITT page text.

capabilities.name: Interface management and SIMOPS for systems (telecoms, fibre, control, power)
capabilities.desc: Company is Lead Interface; Contractor participates in interface management and is responsible for SIMOPS (simultaneous operations) for all its Works; telecoms, fibre, power and control integration points are identified at battery limits; Offshore EPF Contractor is design authority for NPI.
capabilities.risk: Interface count and meeting cadence not stated.
capabilities.impact: Indirects allowance; resource scales with number of interfacing parties.

capabilities.name: Pre-commissioning of E&I and communications systems
capabilities.desc: Point-to-point, insulation resistance and loop tests, instrument set-up and calibration, results to Company; pre-commissioning of all systems and sub-systems in every area; commissioning support is 'as required' with no duration; commissioning methodologies come from the Offshore EPF Contractor.
capabilities.risk: Exclusions list conflicts with 'all systems'; support duration undefined.
capabilities.impact: Open-ended labour allowance.

interfaces.protocol: Not stated (agreed electronic format; regular structured exports; no live or automated interface required for pricing)

rfis.text: Provide the Company systems architecture (ISA-95 level model if used, control system, FMS, historian, LIMS, CMMS, network block diagram) and the IS&T requirements document referred to in the E&I scope.
rfis.impact: Without it every Level 2 and Level 3 boundary is an assumption; Owner architecture is 'Not stated'.

rfis.text: Who supplies, designs, programs and commissions the central control system and the MSA control room, and what does 'integration back to the control room' require of the Contractor (signals, protocol, testing)?
rfis.impact: Decides whether CAP-L2-MIN-02 is install-only or includes PLC/RTU programming and SCADA integration.

rfis.text: Issue the project instrumentation list, I/O list, cable schedule, equipment list and any tagging convention referred to in the E&I scope.
rfis.impact: Instrument and I/O counts cannot be estimated; loop-check effort is open-ended.

rfis.text: Section 18 excludes backbone fibre, CCTV and access control systems, but the Explosives Facility and NPI interface text require installation of cameras, access control points and NVR connection. Which applies? (Extends RFI-011.)
rfis.impact: Unpriced installation or double count at the CCTV, access control and fibre boundary.

rfis.text: MSA communications are 'designed by others', yet the Contractor installs ICT hardware and tests structured cabling. Confirm the Contractor installation and testing scope, and whether WIN-1400-12 should remain Excluded.
rfis.impact: WIN-1400-12 may hide a priced installation scope.

rfis.text: FMS: state the pre-strip duration, fleet list and unit count, who supplies on-board units for free-issued HME, required coverage area, supervision and dispatch staffing basis, and licence term for the Wenco allowance.
rfis.impact: FMS vendor quote and operating resource cannot be sized.

rfis.text: Specify the agreed electronic format, frequency and target Company reporting system for FMS production and movement data exports.
rfis.impact: Export build effort; risk of later live-interface direction.

rfis.text: Who is responsible for grade control sampling, ore and waste classification and block-model updates during pre-strip, and what inventory or reconciliation system applies to stockpiles?
rfis.impact: CAP-L3-MIN-07 stays Clarify; potential unpriced sampling and assay effort.

rfis.text: Is a maintenance management system (CMMS) required for the free-issued HME and construction fleet, and in what format must asset-health and maintenance data be handed to the Company asset register?
rfis.impact: Maintenance system licence and data capture effort.

rfis.text: Is the Contractor free to select its materials control and inventory system, and in what format must inventory reconciliation data be given to the Company Representative?
Weighbridge on the Mine Access Road: who supplies and operates it, what capacity and calibration regime applies, and which system consumes the weight data?
rfis.impact: Supply and system integration cannot be priced.

rfis.text: Provide the Company's applicable IT and cyber security requirements for Contractor systems that interface with Company networks, and confirm whether OT (operational technology) segmentation is required.
rfis.impact: Open-ended compliance effort on temporary IT, FMS and any integration.

rfis.text: Provide the equipment responsibility matrix for radios, the radio licence and frequency position, and the expected date the Company permanent TETRA network becomes available.
rfis.impact: Radio quantities and the duration of the temporary radio solution.

rfis.text: Confirm final models for tower equipment shown as Tbc and who installs the carrier (Telstra) equipment on the mine towers.
rfis.impact: Tower installation quantities and boundary with the carrier.

rfis.text: 'DHHI' appears in the telecoms battery-limit text but is not defined. Identify the party and its role.
rfis.impact: Counterparty for joint planning of fibre crossing the Process Plant boundary.

rfis.text: Is a laboratory information system or results interface required for the Contractor's field laboratory, and will the permanent MSA laboratory need data points or services beyond the building?
rfis.impact: Field laboratory set-up and MSA laboratory services boundary.

assumptions.text: ISA-95 (ANSI/ISA-95, IEC 62264) is used only as a classification framework. The ITT does not mention ISA-95 and does not require compliance with it.

'Not in ITT' means the term or requirement was not found in the extracted ITT page text (638 pages). Scanned images, drawings and figures were not interpreted (limitation inherited from the FLOC workbook).
The FMS is treated as a Contractor system for the pre-strip duration only; the Company's permanent operational FMS is outside the Contract unless directed (SRC-0793).
Site-wide infrastructure (communications, data centres, towers, temporary IT) is assigned a primary domain of Mining because the pre-strip FMS is its principal user. Other domains are listed.
Scope positions are for estimation scoping and are 'Proposed - to confirm', consistent with the input workbook. They are not legal interpretation of the contract.
Capability links to FLOCs follow the input workbook's FLOC-to-EWP mapping unchanged. EWPs added by judgement are flagged in the map.

The tender closing date (07/10/2026 4:00pm AWST) and the RFI cut-off (04/10/2026) have passed (BID-RFI-03). The OPS RFIs may need to be handled as tender qualifications or stated assumptions unless an extension is confirmed.
No amounts, quantities or rates are used. Named products (Wenco FMS, Nokia and Cambium tower equipment, TETRA, Telstra) appear only where the ITT names them.
ISA-95 Level 0 is the physical process (drilling, blasting, haulage, stockpiling). No systems capability is recorded at Level 0.

The pre-strip duration and FMS operating period are not stated in the FMS clause; Contract milestones run from 11/10/2028 to 15/01/2029 and Completion is 30/11/2029 (Bid_Programme), but their relation to pre-strip is not confirmed.

proposed_ewps.title: Fleet management system and material tracking
proposed_ewps.scope: FMS supply, install, commission and operation; dispatch resources; material tracking; production data export; GPS units.
proposed_ewps.rationale: FMS is bundled with data centres in EWP-ICT-01 and is an operating cost, not an installation cost. Needs a vendor quote and a mining estimator.

proposed_ewps.title: Temporary communications, IT, radio and GNSS
proposed_ewps.scope: Temporary telephone, mobile, radio, internet and IT infrastructure; radio licences; GNSS base stations; cyber compliance.
proposed_ewps.rationale: Currently an allowance inside EWP-IND-03 with laydown and water; needs a communications specialist.

proposed_ewps.title: Data centres and site-wide communications installation
proposed_ewps.scope: Remove FMS (to PROP-01). Add site-wide fibre, towers equipment, private LTE and VMR hardware, MSA ICT hardware and structured cabling.
proposed_ewps.rationale: Title and scope under-describe the communications system installation in the E&I scope.

proposed_ewps.title: Instrumentation, controls, telemetry and fire detection interfaces
proposed_ewps.scope: Field instruments, NPI controls, telemetry and integration to the MSA control room, fire panels, CCTV and access control devices.
proposed_ewps.rationale: Systems content is not separable inside EWP-ELE-01 (power, lighting, Village LV).

proposed_ewps.title: Transport, logistics, Company Supplied Items and materials control
proposed_ewps.scope: Add materials control system, inventory register, cargo tracking.

proposed_ewps.title: Temporary works, laydown, water and fuel monitoring
proposed_ewps.scope: Add fuel monitoring (FOBs, meters, software). Temporary communications moves to PROP-02.
proposed_ewps.rationale: Fuel monitoring is a stated requirement with no estimating home.

proposed_ewps.title: Project management, engineering, survey, QA/QC, field laboratory
proposed_ewps.scope: Add field laboratory operation, survey data systems, geotechnical monitoring data and planning deliverables (P6, Schedule of Values).
proposed_ewps.rationale: Laboratory and monitoring data are not described in the EWP.

proposed_ewps.title: Mine pre-strip with production reporting and blast records
proposed_ewps.scope: Add blast monitoring and records, ore and waste classification (subject to RFI), production data export.
proposed_ewps.rationale: Systems records are implicit in mining rates.

proposed_ewps.title: Plant and equipment fleet with maintenance records
proposed_ewps.scope: Add maintenance records, asset-health data and any maintenance management system.
proposed_ewps.rationale: Maintenance data requirement is in the fleet clauses.

proposed_ewps.title: Facility mechanical with weighbridge weighing system
proposed_ewps.scope: Add weighing system supply and integration, subject to supply clarification.
proposed_ewps.rationale: Weighbridge sits in a mechanical bundle with no system content.

proposed_ewps.title: Site management, interface and SIMOPS with systems interfaces
proposed_ewps.scope: Add systems interface management for telecoms, fibre, control and power battery limits.
proposed_ewps.rationale: Interface management allowance should recognise systems interfaces.

proposed_ewps.title: Pre-commissioning with E&I and communications testing
proposed_ewps.scope: Add loop checks, instrument calibration, point-to-point and fibre testing notes.
proposed_ewps.rationale: Scope note only; duration remains open (RFI-018).

levels: The production process itself: drilling, blasting, loading, hauling, dumping, stockpiling, dewatering, waste handling.
Pre-strip mining and construction works in WIN-2100 and WIN-1700 are the physical process.
Sensors, analysers, meters and actuators that sense or manipulate the process.
Instruments, flowmeters, weighing devices, GPS units, cameras.
Monitoring and supervisory control: PLC (programmable logic controller), DCS (distributed control system), SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition), HMI (human-machine interface), alarms.
PLC, RTU, SCADA, HMI, fire alarm panels.
Plant control excluded (SRC-1599). NPI controls and telemetry stated (SRC-1295); platform not stated.
Operations management: dispatch, scheduling, tracking, quality, maintenance and inventory activity models. Called MES (manufacturing execution system) in manufacturing.
FMS, dispatch, material tracking, LIMS (laboratory information management system), CMMS (computerised maintenance management system), historian.
FMS stated (SRC-0788). LIMS, CMMS, historian not stated.
Enterprise planning: ERP (enterprise resource planning), planning, finance, procurement, corporate reporting.
SAP PO on invoices (SRC-2114); LOM and Three Month Plan by Company (SRC-0683).
Industrial network, cybersecurity, communications, time synchronisation, master data, integration and interface management. Not an ISA-95 level; used here to classify enabling capability.
LAN/WAN, fibre, private LTE, radio, data centres.

adaptations: Placed under Level 3 production operations (dispatching, tracking, data collection)
ISA-95 has no fleet or truck dispatch object; mining FMS performs the dispatch and tracking functions.
Blast outcomes and ore classification act as quality control of the product and process.
Material movement from pit to dump and stockpile quantities map to inventory movement and storage.
Field laboratory testing for civil quality has no production counterpart in the ISA-95 model; nearest fit is quality operations.
Fuel and waste are tracked as consumables and by-products.
Added a Cross-cutting class outside Levels 0 to 4
Communications, cyber, time, master data and interface management support all levels and are not ISA-95 levels.
Domains Mining, Processing, Waste Handling and Logistics added as a second dimension
ISA-95 is domain neutral; domains are the user's classification.
